contract: Pure rule for one settled graph node: the outcome routes of the node from decoded links, and follow, proceed or fail-the-Run for one of the nine action outcome classes; no execution, graph walk or retry.
limits: One node and one outcome at a time; fixed bounds of 10,000 links, nine routes and 128-byte IDs; the only error is invalid_input.
No graph walk, skip rule, join, map or loop rule, or rule for the successors after proceed or after a route target completes; no retry, time, I/O, clock, process or storage.
Link targets are not checked to exist and a followed route is not claimed to repair anything; a step that settles through PatternStep.accept/2 never applies a late outcome in pattern-step version 1.

grounding.claim: The production decision returns follow whenever a route exists, for both values of the completed operand; excludes class and route derivation in Elixir.
The production decision returns fail when the class is not completed and no route exists.
The production decision returns proceed when the class is completed and no route exists.
The pinned Cure compiler checks the total pure decision over two Booleans, its three-member result type and the three named laws.

Listed scenarios of the groups routes_of_one_node, nine_classes_total, no_fallback_between_classes, unknown_is_never_retried, class_names_match_pattern_step and invalid_input_and_redaction pass, with two negative controls; finite tests, not a universal proof.
Relies on pinned Cure compilation, Boolean decisions and equality checking; compiler soundness is not locally proved.

The host passes links that Elzoo.RecipeGraph.decode/1 accepted and an outcome class that the engine recorded for the node, and ends the Run on a fail_run decision without running any node again because of this Piece.

telemetry.contract: Pure functions over intrinsic operands emit no observations; callers own instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic data operands and fixed bounds; no ambient settings or selectable policy.

control.contract: No independent process, lifecycle or operational commands.
